name: gtavi-codex
description: Codex port of Bodila51/gtavi-claudecode: a faceless GTA 6 clip desk — find campaigns, trends and moments, cut captioned vertical clips, check the rules, learn from real numbers.

interface.shortDescription: Run a faceless GTA 6 clip desk. Find campaigns, trends, moments — cut captioned vertical clips. You approve every post.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin for running a faceless GTA 6 clipping page with the fewest human actions. Find live clipping campaigns (rate per 1K views, budget left, rules), rank recent GTA 6 videos by views per hour, find live GTA 6 streams, score the best moments in long videos, record live streams and clip chat spikes, cut 1080x1920 vertical clips with word-by-word captions and a hook box, translate clips into 5 languages, check clips against campaign rules before posting, turn repeated fan questions into HOW TO posts, build a verified secrets map, and track payouts from real numbers only. Nothing is uploaded automatically — you approve every post.
defaultPrompt: Use gtavi-codex. Set up my GTA 6 clip page, ask me your 4 questions in one message, then do everything after one 'yes'.
Find live GTA 6 clipping campaigns and rank today's trending videos.
Cut a 1080x1920 vertical clip from a moment with captions and a hook.
Check a clip against campaign rules before posting.
